events_detected.title: 2026 Iran War — Strait of Hormuz Crisis ACTIVE
events_detected.description: Ongoing Iran-US war. IRGC closed Strait of Hormuz. Oil infrastructure under attack. Vessels reporting explosions southeast of Kumzar (Aug 5). Oil residue from attacked vessels on Qeshm Island (Aug 13). Trump claims 'complete control' of Hormuz; Iran refutes. 20M barrels/day shipping disrupted. Biggest global energy disruption in decades.

events_detected.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — WHO PHEIC, Fastest-Growing Outbreak on Record
events_detected.description: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda. 4,665 confirmed cases, 2,184 deaths (as of Aug 12). Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, second-largest ever. WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. Existing treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo — complicating response. Cases surging, spreading faster than health workers can contain.

events_detected.title: US-Japan Joint Currency Intervention — Unraveling
events_detected.description: First joint US-Japan FX intervention in ~15 years (July 31, 2026). US Treasury sold euros (not dollars) to buy yen, avoiding Treasury market disruption. Japan spent estimated $36-59B. Yen rallied to 157 then unwound to 159 by Aug 11 — half the gains lost. 30Y Treasury yield at 5.2% (highest since 2007). ECB not consulted on euro-side intervention. BOJ pressured toward rate hike (Sep/Oct). JGB 10Y at highest since 1996.

events_detected.title: China $148B Commercial Property Crisis — Expiring Land Leases
events_detected.description: China racing to address $148B (1T+ yuan) commercial real estate threat from expiring land leases. Office values in major cities down 40%+ from peaks. Developers defaulted on ~$130B of debt. Foreign Affairs warns cascading defaults could hit Pakistan, Ecuador, Zambia if Beijing forced to address domestic crisis. PBOC maintaining 'appropriately loose' stance, promising 'practical measures as needed'.

events_detected.title: UK Food Security Crisis — Worst in Decades + Wildfire Emergency
events_detected.description: UK facing worst food security crisis in decades due to drought and scorched fields. 75% of England in drought. Government issued national wildfire emergency alert. 10Y gilt yields above 5%, 30Y at 5.7%. BOE rate at 3.75% (7-2 vote to hold). Analysts see markets pricing rate hike by November.

events_detected.title: ECB Set to Deliver Final Rate Hike — Shortest Tightening Drive Since 2011
events_detected.description: Reuters poll: ECB set to deliver final rate hike next month in shortest tightening drive since 2011. ECB cut rates 8x Jun 2024-Jun 2025, then held until June 2026 when they hiked. Lagarde monitoring 'second-round effects' of inflation. ECB was not consulted on US euro-side intervention for yen, creating diplomatic tension.

events_detected.title: Saudi Oil Trade Shifts — US Imports at Zero, Rerouting Around Hormuz
events_detected.description: Saudi Arabia cutting September oil price differential for Asia. US imports of Saudi oil fall to zero. Saudi rerouting oil exports through Mediterranean pipeline to avoid Red Sea/Houthi attacks. Tankers forced on 25-day longer journey around Africa. EIA forecasts Brent averaging $87/barrel in 2026. 0.6M barrels/day disruption expected through end of 2027. US/Gulf states pursuing new routes to bypass Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.

summary.assessment: TWO category-5 events active simultaneously: Iran War/Hormuz closure (war_military) + Ebola PHEIC (pandemic). US-Japan intervention unraveling adds sovereign/currency stress. China property crisis adds financial systemic risk. Multiple convergence vectors: energy + health + currency + geopolitical + financial stability. Overall risk: CRITICAL.
